summary: Template manifest for a Reviewer packet. Reviewer reads milestone-contract, evaluation-sop, and Orchestrator final-packet-index, audits Workflow Orchestrator outputs and every execution-role final output against the original milestone, then checks SOP adherence, evaluation baseline validity, acceptance gaps, packet-chain evidence, risk decision, and final gate judgment.

documents.description: Audit of Workflow Orchestrator outputs and execution-role outputs against the original milestone.
Findings covering milestone alignment, evaluation baseline audit, and acceptance gaps.
Risk acceptance, return, and blocker decisions.
Packet consumption, source scope, strict handoff, and drift audit.

source_scopes: original milestone anchor from Orchestrator or user input
Orchestrator workflow-state, milestone-registry, decision-log, consumption-check outputs, and next-role handoff briefs
all upstream role packets in selected chain
upstream implementer packet when provided for traceability
Product / PRD acceptance criteria when provided in upstream packet chain
